Finally, the red solid line representing "ffn_residual" starts near 0 at layer 0, jumps sharply to approximately 1400 at layer 5, and reaches a plateau of approximately 1480 from layer 7 to 12. It then rises to a higher plateau of approximately 1580 from layer 14 to 20, before dropping sharply to approximately 390 at layer 22 and ending at approximately 620 at layer 23.
